Task 5  
 
 
Task Title  
Build a RAG System  using LangChain framework   
 
Task Goal  
 Use RAG (Retrieval -Augmented Generation)  and LangChain  to answer 
questions based on a PDF document  or Excel -sheet   
 
Instructions  
 Load the provided PDF  or Excel -sheet  as your knowledge base. Then Build 
a RAG system (retriever + generator).
